name: reisotor
description: Einzige Versionsquelle für Reisotor (Backend + Frontend) — siehe backend/scripts/generate-build-info.mjs und frontend/vite.config.ts.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:release-notes && npm run typecheck:all
scripts.build: npm run check && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.generate:screenshots: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build:landing-dist && npm --prefix e2e run generate:screenshots
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix e2e test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.install:all:ci: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix e2e ci
